comment: Sizes, largest first, of the import cycles under src/ that type imports close (strongly connected components; scripts/check-cycles.mjs). Measured after the feed adapters were removed, lowered as merges shrink it. This list only shrinks: a new or larger component fails npm run check:cycles, and so does this list once the tree measures lower, until it is lowered to match. Runtime cycles are not listed because there must be none.
